Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Team liked it, especially the part where it picks up the WhatsApp threads.

Can you send pricing for 40 seats? We'd start with the sales team and bring in customer success in Q1 if it goes well.

Good to hear. 40 seats on annual comes to ₦5,520,000 for the year. Monthly would be ₦540,000 but you lose the 15%.

messages.body:
You have been invited to the following event.

Tilden <> Novatech demo
Thursday 5 Nov 2026 2:00pm to 2:30pm (WAT)

Guests:
amaka.obi@tilden.ng (organiser)
s.adeoye@novatech.io
chidi@novatech.io

Joining info: meet.google.com/xxx-yyyy-zzz

Hello Amaka,

Sorry for the delay, I have been in Abuja all week. I am the COO at Planmoni, we spoke briefly at the fintech meetup.

We are ready to move on this. Kindly send the agreement and I will have our legal look at it. Please use this address, our work mail is having issues.
No problem at all. Sending the agreement across this morning. Good to hear from you Ngozi.

Amaka,

We looked at the numbers again. 2.5 is about where we can land for the first year, anything above that has to go to the board and that pushes us into next year.

If you can meet us there we can sign before the end of next month.

Akin
Understood. Let me see what I can do on ₦2,500,000 and come back to you Monday. One thing that would help, is the 2.5 covering the 18 seats we discussed or the 25?
18 for now. We'll add the rest when the Port Harcourt office opens.

Amaka,

Signed copy attached. Finance will process the invoice this week, our terms are 30 days from receipt.

Who handles onboarding on your side? We'd like to get the team in before the end of the month.

Bisi
Brilliant, thank you Bisi. I'll introduce you to Kelechi today, he runs onboarding and will take it from here.
Thanks for sending this through. Let me take it to the team and come back to you.
Hi Emeka, checking in on this. Any thoughts from the team?
Hi Emeka, following up again. If the timing is wrong just say and I'll come back to you in the new year, no hard feelings.

Seun,

Legal came back with two changes to clause 9 and they want the liability cap raised. Redline attached.

If you can turn this around by Wednesday we'll sign the same week. The number stays at ₦8,400,000.

Ifeoma

Dear Seun,

Please find attached our invoice for October and the VAT schedule for filing. Kindly revert with the signed copy at your earliest convenience.

The filing deadline is the 21st.

Best regards,
Olu Adeniyi
Adeniyi & Associates

Amaka, Chidi here. Sarah added me to the Thursday call.

Writing from my own address, the chidi@ one goes to a shared box that half the team reads.

Two things I'll want to see on the day: how it handles a deal that lives entirely in WhatsApp, and what a manager can and cannot see of my inbox. The second one is why we stopped using the last tool.
